title: Cybersecurity Issue Forces a Major New Mexico Hospital to Divert Patients and Close Clinics
description: A cybersecurity incident at the University of New Mexico Health System forced the diversion of patients from its main hospital and the cancellation of appointments at over 30 clinics. The incident disrupted emergency services, including the state's only Level 1 trauma center, and led to a phased resumption of operations. The nature and extent of the cybersecurity issue remain unclear, and the matter is under active law enforcement investigation.
